description:
List the SEC's SIC industry codes, so you know which code to use with list_companies_by_sic.

With a query (a word from the industry title: "software", "bank", "oil", "pharmaceutical") you get the
matching codes, most companies first, at most 50, each with the code (sic), the SEC's industry title
(description), the SEC office that reviews filers in it (office), and how many companies we hold under it
(companies, of which listed have an exchange ticker). Then call list_companies_by_sic with a code, or
get_company for one company's own code.

With no query you get every code (about 440) as one short line each, "code title (companies)", sorted by
code. That is a long list, so prefer a query.

SIC is the SEC's classification of the filer, assigned when it registers. It is not GICS or NAICS.

Args:
    query: a word to look for in the industry titles (optional)
name: list_sic_codes
title: List SIC Industry Codes
